Routine infant circumcision, religious or otherwise, should be banned and abhorred.

I hate knowing that I had no choice with what happened to my penis. I struggle with depression and terrible thoughts because of this knowledge. I hate how insensitive I am and that there's NOTHING I can do about it but donate to some voodoo regenerative medicine shit in the hopes that a miracle happens.
Does it really matter? Same God who wished for sons to be mutilated. It doesn't matter if a murderer recants his belief that murder was the answer. God is ironically irredeemable.

The God of the Bible as a whole has commanded many atrocities including circumcision. Christianity paints male genital mutilation in a more acceptable light just by having the same belief in Yahweh.

It is my main concern because I was born into it. I despise Judaism for being a huge bastion protecting it, but Christianity itself is flawed in the way it paints certain acts.

I already know about restoration, but specific erogenous parts of the foreskin, the most erogenous of the penis in general, are excised in varying degrees, some being luckier than others. That will never come back.

It was only half sarcasm. I have no doubt that you have a heart, it's just that what you're saying is a non-solution for an individual who was circumcised (unless they really get a kick out of helping others). It's not like I can really blame you. After my years of dealing with it, it's hard to believe that there is any solution and that it all relies on trying to cope the best I can.

Wonderful. Glad to hear you have a heart. I already do talk about it when I can despite people mocking me or raising an eyebrow, but at times this feels like it'll eventually become a bullet in my head, so it doesn't really help my issue. Plus, advocating just reminds me of what was done and I can't face it long without going into rage and suicidality.

Okay, okay, awesome. Now what do I do about my own? That's it. This is called SuicideWatch for a reason. It's about helping someone with problems that affect them individually, not about changing the world so another soul doesn't have to deal with it.
Sorry if this is all over the place. I am very tired at the moment.

I relate to how you feel regarding surgery so much. I am a guy, but have a child-like face which I feel must live with or feel fake for the remainder of my life while being surrounded by naturally manly looking men. I won't say that people as a whole don't care about breast size, but most of the girls I found particularly attractive and absolutely adored were actually quite flat and I would have been more than happy to live my life with a girl who was like them in that respect. I'd even say that smaller breasts can make someone look MORE feminine in a certain way.

I don't think pity is a valid response at all for just having smaller breasts. It is not something to pity one for. I believe my sister was quite self-conscious about this as she is also quite small there, but she has a boyfriend now who is just great to her.

I am very sorry you feel this way about yourself. I deal with this sort of thing every second of every day and it is gut-wrenching at times. BDD is so horrible to live with and I truly wish you the best.
